title: Bendungan Nyang Peuhah Saboh Keurajeuen
intro: Saboh nanggroe nyang meu-ile krueng-krueng, dua boh taman nyang ijo, dan kemakmuran nyang hana meutandingan — teuma peunduduek jih hana jitem peuduli keu Gobnyan nyang bri beureukat keu awaknyan. Watèë teuka peuingat-peuingat njang djihôi awaknjan, awaknjan djimeu-ulang-ulang. Peuë njang seulanjutdjih nakeuh hukôman njang mantong meu-gema sibagoë peuingat. Soe masyarakat jameun nyoe?
clues: Kamoe tinggai di nanggroe nyang that meuberkat sampoe rumoh kamoe na di antara dua boh taman nyang ijo.
Kamoe meunikmati krueng-krueng nyang ji-ile lam tanoh kamoe dan panen nyang le that nyang peunoh rumoh kamoe.
Bah that pih meunan, watèë geutanjoë djihôi keu ta sjakô dan ta’at keu Tuhan geutanjoë, geutanjoë ta meu-ubah deungon sombong.
Keukayaan dan keumudahan geutanjoë ka djipeugot geutanjoë tuwo keu Nyang ka geubri bandum njan.
Teuma teuka kheueh saboh ié raya nyang hana teusangka-sangka nyang jipeuhah penghalang rayeuk nyang ka kamoe peucaya.
Geutanjoë nakeuh ureuëng Saba’, njang nanggroë djih ka djituri deungon Bendungan Ma’rib njang rajek njan.

trial.label: Rhet Geutanyoe
options: Angén nyang teuga jipo nibak langét .

outcome.label: Nasib Geutanyoe
options: Dua boh taman phet geugantoe taman kamoe nyang subur .
Taman kamoe timoh leubeh subur lom .
Kamoe meukubu lam abu gunong meuapui .
Bangsa geutanyoe meupeucah jeut keu dua blah boh sukèe .
outcome.answer: Dua boh taman phet geugantoe taman kamoe nyang subur .

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
